description: This file defines the ConnectionFactory interface for creating and managing AMQP 1.0 connections, including methods for connecting with or without authentication, and a static factory method for instantiation.

classes.name: ConnectionFactory
classes.description: Interface for creating and managing AMQP 1.0 connections, including connection parameters and factory method.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the container-id name used in the client's AMQP Open frame.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname or IP address of the server.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number of the server.

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the character used for separating path components.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the server with specified options and handlers, with or without authentication.
